source.description: Lists the projects of Example Tracker to the control plane, without their items.

setup.help: Asks for the address of the Example Tracker site and registers the adapter with it.

source.connect: Example Tracker asks you to sign in and to choose the projects the adapter may read.
source.access: In Example Tracker, open Settings, then Connected adapters, to change which projects the adapter reads.
source.disconnect: In Example Tracker, open Settings, then Connected adapters, and remove the adapter.
